cases.prompt: Check current agentskills.io best practices against the local skill-review rubric and prepare an update plan.
assertions: The workflow captures the local rubric baseline before evaluating external guidance.
Each recommended new check has a source citation, a mapped axis, an explicit baseline gap, acceptance criteria, and a confidence tier.
Equivalent existing checks are marked covered rather than proposed as new.
The plan prioritizes changes by impact, then confidence.

cases.prompt: Prepare the rubric update plan, but agentskills.io cannot be reached and no fresh source evidence is available.
assertions: The workflow reports that source collection is blocked and does not fabricate current guidance.
Any local artifacts are labeled potentially stale and proposals are downgraded or kept watchlist-only.
The output includes a recheck trigger and does not present a final adoption recommendation as high-confidence.
